title: Umm Shaif Gas Cap and Surface Pressure Boosting: McDermott holds EPCI package 4
publisher: World Oil / Oil & Gas Journal (read from search summaries)
note: Research 25 Nov: awarded 24 Aug 2026, valued by McDermott at over $1bn. Scope is a new surface pressure boosting jacket and topside plus brownfield modifications. Engineering and project management are led from McDermott's UAE offices; fabrication is at its QMW yard in Qingdao. No separate detailed-engineering subcontractor is reported.

title: Umm Shaif Gas Cap package 1: Larsen & Toubro is main contractor, with detailed engineering subcontracted to Technip Energies
publisher: MEED / World Oil (read from search summaries)
note: Research 25 Nov: ADNOC took a $6.2bn FID on Umm Shaif Gas Cap in July 2026 with three EPC packages worth $5.1bn; it did not disclose the contractors. MEED reports L&T Energy Hydrocarbon as main contractor on package 1, which subcontracted detailed engineering to Technip Energies (reported 26 Aug 2026). MEED earlier listed Saipem and Seatrium among bidders for package 1; they are not confirmed awardees. Winners of the remaining package are not named in free sources.

title: North East Bab Phase II scope: Mannesmann Energy to upgrade existing facilities at Al Nouf and Rumaitha/Shanayel
note: Research 25 Nov: the EPC scope is to upgrade existing oil production facilities at Al Nouf and Rumaitha/Shanayel for reliability, efficiency and capacity while they keep operating (brownfield). The 18 Nov AGBI headline 'Adnoc Onshore to upgrade existing oil fields' is probably this same award (unconfirmed).
